verifications.claim: X (formerly Twitter) experienced a significant outage around March 23, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: March 23, 2026 at 9:10 PM Sudden spike... surpassing 4,000 reports (R1); March 23, 2026, 5:24 p.m. ET... bugs popped up (R6); 1:45 PM PT on March 23, 2026... more than 4,000 users complaining (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly confirm a significant outage on or around March 23, 2026, with spikes in reports.

verifications.claim: Thousands of users reported issues accessing the platform.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: spiking around 4,000 reports... nearly 4,300 reports (R1); more than 34,500 reports (R4); users are struggling using X (R6); more than 4,000 users complaining (R7)
verifications.reasoning: All matched references report thousands or tens of thousands of user reports for access issues.

verifications.claim: Issues accessing the platform were primarily on web browsers.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: 60% of the reports were related to the browser version of X (R1); 60 percent of users finding issues logging on to the website (R6); app crashes (60%), website issues (25%) (R7)
verifications.reasoning: R1 and R6 support primary web/browser issues (60%), but R7 contradicts with app at 60% and website at 25%.

verifications.claim: Reports indicated difficulties with logging in.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: the rest around logging in and the mobile app (R1); 14 percent can’t get past the login (R6); login problems (15%) (R7)
verifications.reasoning: All references directly mention login difficulties as part of reported issues.

verifications.claim: Reports indicated difficulties with loading feeds.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: problems loading posts, feeds and notifications (R4); difficulties in loading feeds, posting updates (R7)
verifications.reasoning: References directly state reports of issues loading feeds.

verifications.claim: Reports indicated difficulties with viewing notifications.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Users report problems loading posts, feeds and notifications across mobile and web (R4)
verifications.reasoning: R4 directly supports reports of notification issues; no contradiction, though date slightly differs from main event.

verifications.claim: Downdetector reported a spike in issues starting in the late afternoon (EST) on March 23, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: starting around 1:45 p.m. Pacific (4:45 p.m. EST) (R1); shortly before 4:30 p.m. EST (R6); 1:45 PM PT on March 23, 2026 (R7)
verifications.reasoning: All confirm Downdetector spike on March 23 starting ~4:30-4:45 p.m. EST (late afternoon).

verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: 60% of the reports were related to the browser version (R1); 60 percent ... website (R6); website issues (25%) (R7)
verifications.reasoning: R1 and R6 support 60% website/browser, but R7 states only 25%.

verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: 17 percent are struggling with the app (R6); app crashes (60%) (R7)
verifications.reasoning: R6 supports exactly 17% app issues, but R7 contradicts with 60%.
